title: Transmission spool valve
description: a transmission spool valve part used in an automatic transmission
reference_excerpt: The product in question is identified as a transmission spool valve, specifically item number 4631223000. It is a component of an automatic transmission's main control assembly. The spool valve is made from aluminum and is precisely machined to accommodate various valve components, including a ball check, a poppet, and spool mechanisms. These components work together to control the flow of hydraulic fluid within the transmission assembly. The ruling clarifies that the item is not a complete valve but rather a part of a valve mechanism used to form a spool valve within the transmission assembly.

classification.rationale: A transmission spool valve is a hydraulic/oleohydraulic valve of heading 8481, and Section XVII Note 2(e) expressly excludes articles of heading 8481 from the motor-vehicle-parts heading 8708, even though the part is principally used in an automatic transmission. Because the description is of a 'part' of a spool valve (not the complete valve or a valve body casting), it falls in the residual parts provision 8481.90.90, and absent evidence it is a valve body casting or steel forging, it is classified under the general 'Other' statistical line 8481.90.90.40, consistent with treatment of similar hydraulic valve components in CROSS rulings N348390 and N268111.'
